d: Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine
r: or (shortened) בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H4818 (מֶרְכָּבָה) (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots;
